_doc: Archive of the curated London DS Target List (artifact deleted 2026-10-11). Scores are researched fit judgements 0-10 (fit, WLB, sponsorship, level). Comp is the list's own TC estimate in GBP k. Verification state as of 2026-10-10.
brief: Senior-IC data-scientist roles clearing GBP 150k+ total comp, ranked by fit for a Meta IC5 wanting a step up and better work-life balance.

roles.role: Senior/Staff DS - Measurement, Experimentation & Causal Inference
roles.jd: Own measurement, experimentation and causal-inference methods across PlayStation; design A/B tests and size product impact with PM and engineering.
roles.quals: Strong experimentation + causal inference; Python/SQL; no PhD gate.
roles.fit_note: Bullseye - the exact Meta skillset. Highest fit on the list.
roles.next: Apply now - one focused tailoring pass. Screen UK TC and sponsorship in the first call.

roles.jd: Lead experimentation and product analytics across the listener Experience org; design metrics, run causal analyses, partner with PM and engineering.
roles.quals: No PhD gate; strong applied/product DS; experimentation depth.
roles.fit_note: Strong Staff/product match. Role was Stockholm or London.
roles.next: Posting gone; keep a referral warm for the next Staff req.

roles.jd: Lead DS for fraud, credit, growth and product analytics; set methods and mentor; partner with product.
roles.quals: Bachelor's acceptable; strong applied DS; SQL/Python; experimentation.
roles.next: Apply this week if TC can plausibly clear the floor.

roles.jd: Build models for payments, risk and growth across Ripple's crypto-payments products; experimentation and production ML.
roles.quals: Senior applied DS; Python/SQL; production ML; no PhD gate.
roles.fit_note: Strong content fit; mixed culture evidence.

roles.jd: Run experiments and analyse Google products at scale; partner with PMs and engineers across Ads, Search, YouTube and Chrome.
roles.quals: BSc acceptable for Product DS L5 with a strong applied record; 6-10+ yrs.

roles.next: Apply referral-led to the live London posts.

roles.role: Senior Data Scientist - AI by McKinsey
roles.status_2026_10_10: search page; two Regular/Mid QB posts live
roles.jd: Partner with clients to translate business problems into analytical solutions; build models; contribute to internal frameworks such as Kedro.
roles.quals: Degree-agnostic; strong Python; 5+ yrs; travel expected.
roles.fit_note: Clean applied-DS fit, but client-facing consulting with travel.
roles.next: Only if the WLB trade-off is acceptable.

roles.role: Senior Data Scientist - Operations, TikTok Shop
roles.status_2026_10_10: search page; a Regular/Mid TikTok Shop DS post live
roles.jd: Build models and data products for TikTok Shop growth: metrics, experimentation, product and ops analytics.
roles.quals: Bachelor's+; Python, SQL, ML; experimentation. No PhD required.
roles.fit_note: Clean product/ops DS fit; verify level and stability.
roles.next: Optional after the top five; probe level and stability.

roles.jd: Build graph and production ML over blockchain data for investigations and intelligence products.
roles.quals: Strong production ML; graph/ML depth favoured; senior/staff scope.
roles.fit_note: Graph and production-ML stretch; middling WLB evidence.
roles.next: Recruiter gate first: GBP 150k+ TC, sponsorship, cadence.

roles.fit_note: Weak WLB - 9-12 hour days are a recurring review theme.
